people.imagined: Cold ravine dawn. He sits upright on a flat rock with his hands in his lap, listening, and one long forefinger lifts and taps the rhythm of whatever he hears: pine wind, a distant footstep, the breath of the person looking at him.
people.subject: The moment: sitting very still on a rock in a pine ravine at dawn, head slightly turned as if to hear, one long forefinger lifted and tapping the air. Face: a long, narrow, ascetic old face, deeply lined; skin pale and papery over high cheekbones; eyes half-closed, pale grey-brown, unfocused, turned inward on a sound; thin white brows long and straight; a long thin nose; a thin mouth set in a very faint smile; a fine wispy white beard that hangs to the chest. Hair: white, long, in a simple topknot with a plain pine-wood pin. Body: tall, thin and bony, sitting very upright, hands long and fine. Clothing: a long robe of plain grey hemp, clean and crisp with a crossed collar and wide sleeves, undyed cord sash; over his shoulders a thin pale robe so fine the wind lifts it at one edge. Hands and objects: both hands rest on his knees; every fingernail on the right hand is grown out long, hard, pale and curved like a row of plectra, drawn big in the lower centre; the left nails are square-cut. Background: tall dark pines dissolving in blue-grey mist, a hint of a ravine wall. Light: cold pale dawn from the upper left, a thin edge of silver on the nails. Expression: remote, serene, listening. A faint green-brown wood tint in the air.

people.imagined: Night in the instrument rooms. He is bent under a single lamp over a half-carved board of storm-pine, shavings in his eyebrows, the crushed fingers of his left hand holding the wood steady while he looks round at the door.
people.subject: The moment: bent over a half-carved soundboard at night under one lamp, shavings in his eyebrows, glancing up toward a door. Face: a broad, heavy, bearded face; skin ruddy and rough; thick bushy eyebrows full of pale sawdust, the first thing seen; small suspicious dark eyes; a big nose; a wide mouth drawn tight; a short thick black-grey beard. Hair: black-grey, cropped short, shavings caught in it. Body: heavy, thick-armed, wide-shouldered, hunched. Clothing: a plain grey hemp robe of good cloth, clean at the collar, with sleeves tied back by cords; a leather woodworker's apron dusty with pale shavings. He leans over the bench with his weight on the right forearm and the big back rounded, a halo of pale dust round his head; the curls of pine shaving lie across his boots. The grey hemp robe is covered in fine pale dust at the shoulders, the leather apron nicked by years of tools, and the cord sash holds a small wooden mallet. Hands and objects: the left hand, laid flat on the pine board, has the last two fingers crushed flat and fused, visible and bright in the lamplight; the right holds a small curved chisel; the board has a rough zither shape, pale and fresh. Background: The workshop is dark and warm, zither bodies in rows on racks, a wall hung with chisels, saws and planes in order of size, curls of pale shaving on the floor, a stack of storm-pine boards leaning in the corner, and a small door ajar to the black night. Light: a warm single lamp from the lower left. Expression: a wary, stubborn, absorbed frown, the eyes lifted for a moment from the soundboard toward the door and the lip set, a man who does not want to be disturbed. A faint pale gold wood glow.

people.imagined: A midwinter pre-dawn. She has stopped at a rest in the canon and the room has stopped breathing. Her hands hover above the strings. She is thinking of the twelfth movement and does not let it show.
people.subject: The moment: seated at a zither with both hands hovering motionless above the strings in the middle of a rest, her face utterly still. Face: a small, fine, pale oval face; skin cool and smooth; very still dark eyes looking down, lowered lashes; thin even brows; a small straight nose; a small closed mouth with no expression at all; a faint tension at the corner of the lips. Hair: black and perfectly smooth, parted in the middle, a long low knot at the nape with a plain dark wooden pin. Body: small, slight, composed, straight-backed, perfectly balanced. Clothing: a robe of plain grey hemp, fine and clean, high crossed collar, narrow sleeves, an undyed sash; her right-hand nails are grown long and pale like plectra, her left square-cut. Hands and objects: both hands are held two inches above the silk strings of a dark old zither lying on a low table in front of her; the strings are drawn finely and lit. Background: a bare wood-panelled hall, a single lamp, thin pine shadows on a paper wall. Light: soft lamp light from the upper left, otherwise cold dim. Expression: absolute stillness, a held breath. A faint pale-gold metal gleam on the strings.

people.imagined: A banquet. He has a cup in one hand, the other raised for emphasis, telling the envoy story for the hundredth time, certain the room is with him, his scarlet sash bright as a wound.
people.subject: The moment: at a banquet, one hand raised in a grand gesture, a wine cup in the other, telling a story with a handsome self-satisfied smile. Face: a handsome, long, well-formed face of an ageing beauty; smooth tanned skin with a few fine lines; perfectly arched dark brows; large bright dark eyes shining with self-regard; a straight nose; a full mouth in a practised, charming smile; a neat short beard shaped to a point. Hair: black with silver at the temples, glossy, in a tall neat topknot with a jade pin. Body: tall, upright and elegant, the shoulders thrown back, the chest a little out, a man who knows where the light falls. Clothing: a fine grey hemp robe, immaculate, with a crossed collar, and round the waist a broad, bright scarlet silk sash, the brightest object in the picture. Hands and objects: the right hand lifted in a grand gesture, the long nails polished; the left holds a small porcelain wine cup, a drop of wine at its rim. Background: a warm banquet hall hung with lanterns, blurred guests leaning in with their cups, a long table of small dishes, a screen painted with pines behind him, and a servant bending with a flask. Light: golden lantern light from the upper left, flushing his cheeks. Expression: a bright, practised, self-satisfied smile, the bright eyes shining at his own story, an old tale told once too often. A faint warm orange-red glow.

people.imagined: In the string room, counting silk threads under her breath, humming a half-tone flat, twisting a new string between ivory-coloured fingers, a coil of thin green wire on her wrist.
people.subject: The moment: seated at a work bench twisting a silk string between her fingers, humming slightly flat with her eyes on the thread. Face: a plain, narrow, patient face; skin tanned; dark eyes lowered to the work, narrowed; straight brows; a small nose; a mouth shaped round a hum; a faint furrow between the brows. Hair: black with a grey streak, bound up under a plain grey cloth. Body: small, thin and bent over the work. Clothing: a grey hemp robe, clean and neat, sleeves tied back with cord; a leather apron; on her left wrist a loose coil of very thin green malachite wire. She sits upright on a low stool with the elbows close, the thread running taut between two hands and a peg; her face is lit from below by the pale silk. The grey hemp robe has the sleeves tied back, the apron smeared with fine pale dust, and on a loop at her belt a pair of tiny bronze scissors. Hands and objects: the fingertips of both hands are the colour of old ivory, stained pale by silk dust, large in the foreground; she twists three silk threads into a fine cord; spools of thread hang on a rack. Background: The workroom has racks of coloured silk skeins in every shade, a spool frame, a pot of green wire on a shelf glittering faintly, a window of pine branches, and a small teapot on a charcoal stove with a thin plume of steam. Light: soft window light from the upper left. Expression: an absorbed, counting look, the eyes unfocused on the string and the lips moving through the beats, humming a shade flat. A faint pale-green metal glimmer from the wire.

people.imagined: The ravine road with the patrol. He plays a marching phrase on a zither slung at the hip, striding, the green soldier's cord pulled out of his sleeve for the captain and then thrust back when he sees an old man in the distance.
people.subject: The moment: marching on a road, glancing over his shoulder and shoving a green soldier's cord up into his sleeve. Face: a strong, handsome, hard face; brown skin; thick straight brows; keen narrow eyes with a sideways look; a straight nose; a firm mouth in a half-smirk; a clean-shaven chin. Hair: black, in a high tight topknot, no ornament. Body: broad-shouldered, athletic, a soldier's stride. Clothing: a grey hemp robe of good cloth, cut shorter and tied for marching, the sleeves snug at the wrist; a leather belt; a short zither on a strap across the back. The sleeves are fitted with leather cuffs and the sash is a broad soldier's belt with a flat brass buckle; his topknot is bound with a plain black cord and the zither's strap is padded at the shoulder. Beneath the hem, his boots are of stiff leather, dusty to the ankle, and a green plaited cord's end hangs from the sleeve he is stuffing it into. Hands and objects: the right hand stuffs a plaited green cord into the left sleeve, the cord's end showing; the left fist is closed on the strap. Background: a pine ravine road, blurred soldiers in leather marching behind, a green banner without any marks. The road runs along a deep pine ravine with mist rising from the bottom, the soldiers behind in a loose column with spears, an unmarked green banner, and the grey, stern shape of an old man at the roadside far off, partially hidden by a tree trunk. Light: bright hard daylight from the upper left. Expression: a brisk, defiant, slightly furtive look over the shoulder, the chin tucked and the eyes quick, daring anyone to ask about the cord. A faint green-brown wood tint.

people.imagined: On the terrace at midday, nodding off against a pine with his zither half in his lap, a red pillow-crease down his cheek, one eye barely open, with an empty pine-nut bucket at his feet.
people.subject: The moment: slumped against a pine trunk at midday, eyes half open, a deep red crease across his cheek. Face: a round, soft, drowsy face; heavy-lidded eyes barely open; the red crease line from a pillow prominent across the left cheek, drawn large; soft round brows; a snub nose; a loose half-smile; flushed skin. Hair: tousled brown hair sticking up on one side, a pine needle in it. Body: soft, round-shouldered, sprawled, one leg stretched. Clothing: a grey hemp robe of good cloth, clean and slightly rumpled, the collar crooked; an undyed sash loose. His head is tilted against the bark, the neck bent, one arm flung out loose; the belly rises under the robe and a small string of drool glints at the lip. The grey hemp robe is rumpled with a pine needle caught in the collar, the undyed sash trails on the ground, and one shoe is off and lying a few steps away. Hands and objects: both hands rest on a small zither in his lap; at his feet an empty wooden bucket. Background: The pine terrace is dappled with sunlight, a wooden bucket empty beside him, a line of other students working in a blur at the next level down, a squirrel watching from a branch, the soft whisper of wind in needles, and a pale gold haze rising from the ravine. Light: warm midday light from the upper left through branches. Expression: a sleepy, contented half-smile, the eyes half open and unfocused and a deep red crease from the bark across one cheek. A faint pale green.

people.imagined: In a practice hall, she flips a coin behind her back to decide, a new coloured thread knotted into her hair today, while a patient young man waits with a tuned zither.
people.subject: The moment: flipping a coin over her shoulder without looking, a quick sly smile on her face. Face: a sharp, lively, narrow face; bright, quick dark eyes; arched brows; a pointed chin; a small mischievous mouth; high cheekbones. Hair: black, in a long braid with a bright orange thread knotted at the front and several other bright threads of different colours tied along its length, each one distinct as the braid swings. Body: slim, quick and upright, standing with her weight on the right hip and the left arm swung back, an energetic posture. Clothing: a grey hemp robe, clean and trim, with a crossed collar, an undyed sash and the sleeves pushed up to the elbow; a plectrum case of bamboo at her belt. Hands and objects: the right hand behind her back flicks a small copper coin in a high arc; the left holds a zither plectrum. Background: a bare, clean practice hall with polished boards, a low zither on a table, a paper window glowing with morning light, and blurred in the corner a patient young man in grey holding a tuned zither on his knees and watching the ceiling. Light: bright side light from the upper left. Expression: a playful, sly, arbitrary smile, the small mouth tucked up at one corner and the quick dark eyes sparkling, a girl who tosses the coin before she decides. A faint pale metal glint.

people.imagined: He is just sitting down at a long table and has knocked on its edge, head tilted, to hear it ring, a quiet pleased look on his face.
people.subject: The moment: knocking a knuckle on a table edge with his head tilted, listening for the ring. Face: a plain, earnest, mild face; brown skin with grey stone-dust in the creases; ears large; eyes half-closed in listening; mild brows lifted; a wide nose; a gentle mouth with a faint smile. Hair: brown, short and bristling, grey with stone dust. Body: stocky, small and broad, with miner's shoulders hunched in toward the table and the head cocked, the big ears standing out. Clothing: a grey hemp robe of good cloth, clean but a size too large, the sleeves folded back twice; a plain sash; grey stone dust in the folds of the knuckles. Hands and objects: the right knuckles tap a smooth wood table edge; the left hand holds a small tuning bell, still and open. Background: The meal hall is long and plain with rows of dark wooden tables and benches, bowls of millet and pine nuts, a few students blurred in the background eating in silence, shafts of pale window light across the floor, and a small bronze bell hung on a post. Light: soft light from the upper left. Expression: a mild, humble, satisfied smile, the eyes half closed and the whole face given over to the ring of the wood. A faint metallic ring-glint.

people.imagined: On the rim above the ravine, she grins at a pilgrim with a stack of copied pages in her arms and a bamboo flute through her sash, the missing front tooth in the middle of a confident smile.
people.subject: The moment: grinning wide at a pilgrim, a stack of loose pages held against her chest, a bamboo flute through her sash. Face: a wide, cheeky, freckled face; bright black eyes; strong straight brows; a snub nose; a broad grin with a clear gap where a front tooth is missing, big and plain. Hair: short, rough black hair tied up with a bamboo thread. Body: small, wiry and bold, leaning toward the pilgrim with her chin up and her shoulders squared. Clothing: a grey hemp robe of good cloth, clean, with a neatly crossed collar and the sleeves pushed up; a sash of undyed cloth tied in a loose knot with a long bamboo flute thrust through it, a plain tube with a tassel of green thread, the flute's length in the lower frame. Hands and objects: the right arm hugs a pile of paper sheets with little drawings of dots and lines, hugged tight against the chest; the left hand makes a blessing gesture. Background: Behind her the rim path runs along the edge of a deep ravine of pines in mist, a wooden rail, a pilgrim's broad straw hat and grey cloak in blur, a distant waterfall, and a brightening sky of pale blue streaked with cloud. Light: bright cool light from the upper left. Expression: a brazen, persuasive grin, the front-tooth gap showing and the bright eyes holding the pilgrim's, a girl already counting the offering. A faint green bamboo tint.

people.imagined: On the lower terrace, sitting still but his right hand taps the quarry-hammer beat on his thigh, over and over, while he looks calmly at the marching drill beyond.
people.subject: The moment: sitting still on a terrace with his right hand tapping a steady beat on his thigh, looking calmly forward. Face: a calm square young face; skin tanned grey with stone dust; steady dark eyes; level brows; a broad nose; a quiet closed mouth. Hair: short black, with a fine grey stone dust powdered through it. Body: broad-shouldered, solid and strong for his age, the back straight and the shoulders relaxed. Clothing: a grey hemp robe, clean, with a plain undyed sash and the sleeves rolled to the elbow. Hands and objects: the right hand, lifted slightly above the thigh, blurred at the top of its tap; the left, square and stone-dusted, holds a small drum stick and rests still on the left knee. Background: The terrace is a flat stone shelf above a pine ravine, a row of students seated in grey at the next level with their zithers, a drill of marchers in the distance in a blur, a quarry hammer propped by his foot, and a soft grey sky. Light: soft grey daylight from the upper left. Expression: a steady, level, untroubled gaze, the quiet mouth closed and the dark eyes fixed ahead, as dependable as the beat. A faint brown-yellow earth tint.

people.imagined: Remembered: the abbot of the withered tree playing his zither under the pines, his own tree-bark robe grey like the trunk behind him, a faint ghost of leaf-drop starting in the branches.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait of an abbot of fifty-five seated cross-legged under a great pine, playing a pine zither with a calm face, the bark behind him already pale and dry. Face: a lean, serene monk's face; shaved head; skin pale brown; closed or half-closed eyes; calm straight brows; a long nose; a gentle faint smile; a deep line on each side of the mouth. Hair: none; a shaved scalp marked with nine small round scars. Body: tall, thin and still, upright in a lotus pose, the spine straight as the pine behind him. Clothing: a plain travelling robe of pale grey-brown cloth, thin and light so that it stirs in the wind, the colour of dry bark, clean and carefully hemmed, a monk's deliberately simple garment. Hands and objects: both hands on the strings of a dark long pine zither across his knees; a string of twelve pine-seed beads hangs from his wrist. Background: a great pine whose lower branches are brown and bare, the grey ravine wall, mist drifting among the lower trunks, and a few fallen needles on the stone around him. Light: dim grey light from the upper left, faint on the shaved scalp. Expression: a calm, absorbed, faintly smiling look, the eyes closed or half closed and the face turned a little toward the strings. The whole picture faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened. A faint green-brown wood tint.

people.imagined: Remembered: the master maker on the last evening, holding up an unstrung zither to the light of the window, running a thumb along the board, content.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait of the old master zither-maker at sixty, holding up an unstrung zither body to a window and looking along it. Face: a warm, broad, wrinkled face; skin brown and leathery; silver-white thick eyebrows; kind small dark eyes narrowed in craft; a wide nose; a content, broad mouth; a white beard trimmed square. Hair: thick white hair tied back under a grey cloth. Body: heavy, broad and upright, half turned to the window with his weight forward and his beard stirring slightly with his breath. Clothing: a grey hemp robe of good cloth, clean, with the sleeves tied back; a leather apron dusty with pale shavings. Hands and objects: both hands hold a long pale zither body, unstrung and without pegs, at eye level, the right thumb running along its edge; on the bench beside him a coil of silk strings tied with a red thread. Background: an old workshop, racks of seasoned boards in the shadows, a long row of hanging tools, curls of shavings on the floor, a half-carved zither on a stand, a low charcoal brazier, and through the window the last orange light over a ravine and the pines. Light: warm low light from the upper left. Expression: a content, expert, narrowed look along the wood, the kind small eyes critical and the broad mouth relaxed. The whole picture faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened. A faint wood-gold tint.

people.imagined: In the drying yard among stacked pine boards, hefting one in both hands and counting aloud in sixes, the whole yard counting after him, while one board is set quietly apart under a cloth.
people.subject: The moment: in a timber yard, hefting a long pale pine board in both hands and counting aloud, mouth open on a number. Face: a square, stolid, brown face; thick dark brows; small shrewd eyes; a flat nose; a heavy jaw with a rough short beard; the mouth open mid-count. Hair: black, tied back with a leather thong. Body: thick, strong and square, the legs planted wide and the thick arms taking the weight of the board across his chest, the muscles standing; the head tipped slightly back as he counts. Clothing: a grey hemp robe, clean, with the sleeves rolled to the elbow; a leather apron stained with pale resin; a wide belt with a small wooden measuring stick tucked into it. Hands and objects: both hands hold the long pale board across his chest. Background: a drying yard ranked with stacks of pale boards separated by sticks, each stack with a small painted dot, a tall dark pine at the edge, a thin mist in the lower ground, and under a cloth in the corner a single board kept apart. Light: clear light from the upper left. Expression: a stolid, meticulous look, the small shrewd eyes fixed on the grain and the mouth open mid-count, nothing in the face but the number. A faint pine-green tint.

people.imagined: On the rim before the echo walls, a pine cone on a cord swung high, a big laugh, while the walls rattle back at her; pilgrims beside her stop and listen.
people.subject: The moment: laughing out loud on a high rim, swinging a pine cone on a cord above her head. Face: a round, rosy, laughing face; crinkled bright eyes; full cheeks; a wide mouth open in a big laugh; a short nose; strong dark brows. Hair: black in a thick coil, a pine needle tucked in. Body: plump, strong and cheerful, the broad body thrown back in the laugh with the right arm high, the round cheeks rosy and the neck creased. Clothing: a grey hemp robe, clean, with wide sleeves that fall back to the elbow; an undyed sash tied in a bow. Hands and objects: the right hand whirls a large brown pine cone on a cord overhead, a blur at the top of its circle, the long pale nails showing on the cord; the left holds her plectrum. Background: The grey rock wall behind her is streaked with moss and rust-coloured bands, a few small ferns in the cracks, pilgrims in straw hats standing in a loose line below with their heads tilted, and a wide pale sky with a high thin cloud and a hawk. Light: bright morning light from the upper left. Expression: a loud, merry, open-mouthed laugh with the eyes crinkled bright, a woman delighted by her own noise. A faint green wood tint.

people.imagined: She sits quietly in the string room winding silk, her braid with a grey streak, singing the pines' phrase under her breath, while her cousin hovers by the door.
people.subject: The moment: seated at a winding frame, softly singing, a grey streak in her braid. Face: a thin, quiet, pale brown face; gentle dark eyes lowered; neat brows; a small nose; a closed mouth singing softly; flecks of green dust on the cheeks. Hair: a long black braid over her shoulder with a distinct streak of grey-white as wide as two fingers that shines silver. Body: slight and quiet. Clothing: a neat, clean grey hemp robe with a crossed collar and the sleeves tied back; a small pouch of green wire at her belt. Hands and objects: both hands wind green-tinged silk on a wooden spool. She sits straight with her elbows in, the spool turning in her slender fingers, her mouth shaping a low note; the grey streak in her braid is as wide as two fingers and shines silver. Background: The room is full of hanging silk skeins and winding frames, a small window of white light with a pine branch in it, a miner's pick hung on a nail as a keepsake, a cup of tea going cold, and a young man's shape at the doorway, her cousin, waiting. Light: soft window light from the upper left. Expression: a humble, quiet, singing look, the gentle eyes lowered and the closed mouth soft on the note. A faint pale green.

people.imagined: In the middle of a movement he cannot stay in, shifting in his seat, his belt notched with tally marks, plucking louder than the walls answer.
people.subject: The moment: playing loudly on a zither while twisting restlessly in his seat, eyes on the door. Face: a broad, tanned, impatient face; bright restless dark eyes cast sideways; heavy brows; a snub nose; a mouth set in a pout. Hair: black hair roughly tied. Body: wiry and big-handed, perched on the very edge of the seat with one knee up and the heel jittering, the shoulders twisted toward the door and the neck craned; his hands are rough with woodcutter's calluses. Clothing: a grey hemp robe, clean but rumpled, a leather belt notched with a long row of small cuts, a woodcutter's small hatchet worn at the back. Hands and objects: both hands hard on the strings. Background: The pine hall is dim, with a row of other students at their zithers in blur, a bright rectangle of open doorway with the green of the ravine beyond, a few dust motes in the beam, and a bamboo screen half drawn. Light: bright light from the doorway at the right. Expression: a restless, eager, sulky look, the bright dark eyes pulled sideways to the open door and the mouth set in a pout, wanting to be gone. A faint green wood tint.

people.imagined: At a recital, biting the inside of her cheek at someone else's wrong note, her face smooth and sweet above it, her own hands ready on the strings.
people.subject: The moment: seated at a zither, biting the inside of her cheek, hands poised for a shrill note. Face: a pretty, sharp face; the left cheek visibly pulled in at the corner where she bites it; cold bright eyes; thin arched brows; a narrow nose; a thin smile. Hair: black, in an immaculate high knot with a silver pin. Body: slim, poised and arrogant, sitting with a perfectly straight back and the chin lifted, the left cheek drawn in at the corner by the bite. Clothing: a grey hemp robe of fine cloth, spotless, with a high crossed collar and the sash tied in a precise flat bow; the silver pin in her hair catches the light. Hands and objects: both hands hover over the strings like blades, the nails of the right long and sharp. Background: The hall behind her is pale and spare, with a row of seated students in blurred grey and a few faces turned toward her, one boy covering his ears; lamps hang from the beams, the wood floor is polished to a shine, and a paper screen shows the dark shapes of pines. Light: bright light from the upper left. Expression: a cold, contemptuous, thin smile, the bright eyes fixed on someone out of frame with the cheek drawn in, a girl waiting for a mistake. A faint green.

people.imagined: Before dawn, tuning the heir's zither by lamp, turning his head just a beat late as someone speaks to him, as if the words must be tuned first.
people.subject: The moment: tuning a zither before dawn by lamp, head tilting a beat late toward a speaker. Face: a plain, gentle, earnest face; mild brown eyes, a beat late; level brows; a straight nose; a mouth about to answer. Hair: short brown, neatly combed. Body: lean, careful and still, sitting cross-legged before the zither with his back straight, the head tilting a fraction late toward a voice from the left. Clothing: a clean, neat grey hemp robe with the sleeves tied back and a plain sash; a small tuning fork of pale metal lies on the floor beside his knee. Hands and objects: the right hand on a tuning peg; the left plucking a string, the hands at work without a pause. Background: The hall is dark and cold before dawn, a single lamp on a low stand throws a yellow pool, the boards are bare, a paper window shows a grey sliver of coming dawn, and beyond the lamp's reach a small figure sits in the shadows, perfectly still, with her hands on a zither. Light: warm lamp light from the lower left. Expression: a sincere, slow, earnest look, the mild brown eyes arriving a beat late at the speaker and the mouth just parting to answer. A faint gold string glint.

people.imagined: Drumming on a rail with both hands, a green cord knotted at his wrist, his gaze on a column of marchers.
people.subject: The moment: drumming on a wooden rail with both hands, eyes on a distant marching column. Face: a lean, hard-set young face, flushed with effort; fierce dark eyes fixed on the road; strong straight brows; a firm mouth; a muscle in the jaw. Hair: black, in a long plait tied with a plain cord, swinging with the beat. Body: lean, wiry and restless, standing at the rail with the shoulders squared, the elbows loose and the head up, the body swaying with the rhythm. Clothing: a grey hemp robe, clean, with the sleeves pushed up; a faded green soldier's cord knotted tight round the left wrist, plainly visible; a pair of drumsticks tucked in his belt. Hands and objects: both hands raised and mid-beat on the wooden rail, the knuckles pale. Background: The terrace edge looks across a ravine to a distant road where a column of soldiers marches in a thin dark line under an unmarked green banner, pines in mist below, a hawk gliding, and a second boy, stocky and calm, drumming softly on his knee beside him in blur. Light: bright afternoon light from the upper left, hard on the rail and the drumming hands. Expression: an eager, burning, hungry stare at the distant column, the fierce eyes unblinking and the mouth firm, a boy wanting to march. A faint green.
